what: Pressing the MENU button makes paint drip down from the top of the screen to cover it. There is one stream every 70px of screen width, and each line flows an extra 0 to 30px by simplex noise (x is line index × .15, time in 1.2s units), so the lower edge undulates and joins in rounded curves. It starts slow at 3 × .25 px per frame, speeds up with (progress^.5) to as much as 7x as it goes down, and the undulation grows to 1.6x. The streams stop 40px above the bottom of the screen and keep undulating while covering (unlike the original, it does not move on to a “fully open” state). Pressing again hides the menu panel immediately, and the paint retracts upward at 30px per frame. The color is one of three skin colors, chosen each time it opens

options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Menu panel that shows instantly on open and hides instantly on close (optional)
options.[data-fx-part=close]: Close buttons and links inside the panel (optional, multiple)
options.[data-fx-part=canvas]: Canvas to paint on (optional, created if missing)
options.colors: Skin variable names (comma-separated), default --kf-accent, --kf-accent-soft, --kf-warning — brand uses --site-green, --site-purple, --site-yellow
options.back: Collecting speed (px/frame), default 30 — never pass 0 or the panel breaks
options.below: Extra distance scrolled below the screen (px), default 40
options.over: Past this distance it fills with one color and stops (px), default 150 — if larger than below, it does not pass through and keeps swaying (same as the original)

use: …Close
note: Fires fx:open and fx:close on open and close. Runs by frame count as in the original, so on a 120Hz screen it covers twice as fast. The canvas keeps drawing while open (same as the original)

from.where: shared.js .kn-drip (original dripping.js — dripDist 70·fallSpeed 3·retractSpeed 30·wobble 15·easePower .5·overshoot 150·stream cap 40px below the screen, simplex-noise 4.0.1)
